name: Apocalust
source:
You are a young man and budding photographer. You live an average and moral life, just trying to figure things out in the world until you come into contact with an ancient, otherworldly relic, granting you a powerful set of "strange" and "meta physical" abilities.
With these new set of powers, you attempt to go back to your normal life and routine... but that soon proves difficult as giving in to your own lust and greed becomes far too easy when your mind and body is empowered and corrupted by the ancient relics touch.
Live a double life, as you try to balance multiple growing romances and relationships while protecting yourself from the shadows in the dark, whose aim, yet unknown, could be to take it all away from you.
Pick a side to stand for, be it good, evil or somewhere in the grey. The ramifications of your choices and actions will have a ripple effect across your small town, changing not just your life and relationships, but the whole town and eventually... the world.
translation:
你是一名年轻的摄影新秀，一直过着普通而守规矩的生活，努力摸索自己在世界中的位置。直到你接触到一件来自异界的古老遗物，获得了一整套强大而“奇异”、超越物质世界的能力。
得到这些力量后，你试图重返原本的生活与日常……但很快便发现，这并不容易。古老遗物的影响，在强化你身心的同时也将其腐化，让你太容易屈从于自己的欲望与贪婪。
你开始过起双重生活，一边维系多段不断发展的恋情与人际关系，一边保护自己，提防潜伏在黑暗中的势力。他们的目的尚不明确，却可能想夺走你拥有的一切。
选择自己的立场吧：善、恶，或者两者之间的灰色地带。你的选择与行动会在小镇上引发连锁反应，改变的不仅是你的人生与感情，还会是整座小镇，最终……甚至整个世界。
